title: Greek-Style Pan-Seared Fish
description: A simple and flavorful Greek-inspired dish featuring pan-seared fish. Serve with a squeeze of lemon and a side of your favorite vegetables.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillets (4-6)
ingredients.notes: Choose a firm white fish such as halibut or cod.

ingredients.name: Greek Seasoning
ingredients.notes: A mix of oregano, thyme, and rosemary.

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the fish fillets with salt, pepper, and Greek seasoning.
Add the garlic to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the fish fillets to the skillet and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and squeeze lemon juice over the top of the fish.
Serve the fish hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
